recent_posts.title: Apache Flink 1.20.4 Release Announcement
recent_posts.summary: Apache Flink 1.20.4 has been released as the fourth bug fix update in the 1.20 series. It includes 41 bug fixes, vulnerability fixes, and minor improvements. Notable fixes address RocksDB state TTL class loader issues, SQL hint dropping when combining SELECT statements, wrong results from STDDEV/VAR functions with FILTER conditions, unaligned checkpoint recovery failures, PyFlink thread mode issues, sensitive data exposure in debug logs, and Flink WebUI breakage in Chrome 144+. Improvements include updated cipher suite defaults, dependency upgrades (lz4-java to 1.10.3, pemja to 0.5.6), and documentation redirect enhancements. All users on Flink 1.20 are strongly recommended to upgrade.

recent_posts.title: Apache Flink CDC 3.6.0 Release Announcement
recent_posts.summary: Apache Flink CDC 3.6.0 has been released with several major additions: Flink version support extended to 1.20.x and 2.2.x, JDK bumped to version 11, new Oracle Source and Apache Hudi Sink Pipeline connectors, PostgreSQL Schema Evolution support, Lenient mode schema evolution for the Fluss connector, and VARIANT type with JSON parsing in the Transform framework. Pipeline connector improvements span Iceberg (AWS Glue and BigQuery catalog support), StarRocks (DDL support), Paimon (VARIANT type, write parallelism), and Kafka (complex type serialization). Numerous bug fixes address MySQL CDC issues including MySQL 8.0+ support, binlog reading edge cases, and data loss scenarios, plus MongoDB and Oracle CDC fixes.

recent_posts.title: Flink Community update for March 2026
recent_posts.summary: Monthly Apache Flink community update for March 2026 covering technical developments, releases, and governance. Key highlights include: Kubernetes Operator 1.14.0 with FlinkBlueGreenDeployment fixes, Apache Flink Connector Parent 2.0.0 and Connector AWS 6.0 releases (both Flink 2.0 compatible), and Flink Agents 0.2.0 adding Embedding Models, Vector Stores, MCP Server, and async Java execution. Technical updates include watermark improvements, checkpoint recovery enhancements, table planner fixes, Kafka connector update to 4.2.0, and JDBC catalog improvements. Active FLIPs include a native S3 filesystem (FLIP-555), immutable column constraints (FLIP-566), CDC PTF support (FLIP-564), adaptive scheduler rescale history (FLIP-495), and TLS certificate renewal (FLIP-523). Flink 2.3 release planning is underway.

recent_posts.title: Apache Flink Kubernetes Operator 1.14.0 Release Announcement
recent_posts.summary: Apache Flink Kubernetes Operator 1.14.0 has been released, introducing native Blue/Green deployment support as its headline feature. The new `FlinkBlueGreenDeployment` custom resource enables zero-downtime upgrades for stateful streaming applications by running two parallel environments, managing savepoints automatically, and switching traffic only after the new deployment is stable. The release covers three key scenarios: full Blue-Green transitions triggered by spec changes, in-place updates for non-critical config changes, and suspend/resume lifecycle control. Helm chart and Docker images are available for immediate use.

recent_posts.title: Apache Flink Agents 0.2.0 Release Announcement
recent_posts.summary: Apache Flink Agents 0.2.0 is now available, bringing event-driven AI agents to Flink's streaming runtime. This preview release adds Java API parity with Python (embedding models, vector stores, MCP server support), expanded ecosystem integrations (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Elasticsearch), a redesigned memory system with sensory, short-term, and long-term memory types, and durable execution at code-block granularity. The release supports Flink versions 1.20, 2.0, 2.1, and 2.2, enabling developers to build autonomous agents that process high-volume event streams with millisecond latency and exactly-once consistency.

recent_posts.title: Apache Flink Agents 0.1.1 Release Announcement
recent_posts.summary: Apache Flink Agents 0.1.1 is now available with 11 bug fixes, vulnerability patches, and minor improvements. Key fixes include resolving tool call issues in Tongyi and OpenAI chat models, fixing Python state serialization problems with Flink checkpoints, addressing Ollama compatibility with v0.12.10+, and correcting Windows test failures. The release also fixes Python async execution with Flink checkpoints and improves event logging. Users are strongly encouraged to upgrade from 0.1.0.

recent_posts.title: Apache Flink 2.2.0: Advancing Real-Time Data + AI and Empowering Stream Processing for the AI Era
recent_posts.summary: Apache Flink 2.2.0 introduces AI-focused features including ML_PREDICT for LLM inference and VECTOR_SEARCH for real-time vector similarity search. The release enhances materialized tables with optional freshness clauses and bucketing support, improves delta joins with CDC source support and caching, and adds balanced task scheduling for better load distribution. New connector capabilities include rate limiting for scan sources and skew-aware split assignment. PyFlink gains async function support for external service queries with retry mechanisms. The release includes 73 contributors, 9 FLIPs, and resolves over 220 issues.

recent_posts.title: From Stream to Lakehouse: Kafka Ingestion with the Flink Dynamic Iceberg Sink
recent_posts.summary: Apache Flink's Dynamic Iceberg Sink enables real-time ingestion of thousands of evolving Kafka topics into a lakehouse without manual intervention or job restarts. The pattern automatically handles schema evolution, creates new tables dynamically based on record metadata, and adapts to partitioning changes by leveraging schema registries and late binding. This eliminates operational overhead compared to traditional static pipelines that require restarts for every schema change or new topic, making it ideal for high-velocity data environments with frequently changing schemas.

recent_posts.title: Apache Flink 2.1.1 Release Announcement
recent_posts.summary: Apache Flink 2.1.1 has been released with 25 bug fixes, vulnerability patches, and minor improvements. Key fixes include resolving NPE issues in RocksDB state backend, fixing checkpoint recovery problems after rescaling with unaligned checkpoints, addressing security vulnerabilities in PyFlink logging, and correcting non-deterministic MAP function behavior with duplicate keys. The release also upgrades dependencies to mitigate CVE-2025-48924 and fixes issues with ForSt state backend data copying during failover.

recent_posts.title: Apache Flink 2.0.1 Release Announcement
recent_posts.summary: Apache Flink 2.0.1 has been released with 51 bug fixes, vulnerability patches, and minor improvements. Key fixes include resolving memory leaks in skewed join optimization, addressing checkpoint recovery issues after rescaling, fixing watermark alignment deadlocks, and patching security vulnerabilities in PyFlink logging. The release also updates dependencies including Parquet to 1.15.2 and Log4j to 2.24.3 for critical security fixes. Users are strongly encouraged to upgrade from earlier Flink 2.0 versions.
